faqs.question: When are you open?
faqs.answer: We are open Tuesday to Saturday 9am to 7pm. Closed Sunday and Monday.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: Book online at luna-hair.test/book or call 555-0142. A $15 deposit is taken at booking.

faqs.question: How much does a haircut cost?
faqs.answer: Women's cut $55, men's cut $35, kids under 12 $25. Colour starts at $95.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Please give 24 hours notice. Late cancellations lose the $15 deposit.

faqs.question: Do I need a patch test for colour?
faqs.answer: Yes, we do a free patch test at least 48 hours before any colour service.

faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: Open 5am to 11pm Monday to Friday and 7am to 8pm on weekends.

faqs.question: How much is a membership?
faqs.answer: Monthly membership is $39, annual is $390. There is a $25 joining fee.

faqs.question: How do I cancel my membership?
faqs.answer: Memberships can be cancelled with 30 days written notice at the front desk or by emailing frontdesk@ironworks.test.

faqs.question: Do you offer day passes or trials?
faqs.answer: A day pass is $12. New visitors get a free 3-day trial pass at the front desk.

faqs.question: What classes do you run?
faqs.answer: We run yoga, spin and HIIT classes daily. The timetable is at ironworks.test/classes and is included in membership.

faqs.question: Do you do emergency call-outs?
faqs.answer: Yes, 24/7. Call our emergency line on 555-0199. The call-out fee is $120 plus parts and labour.

faqs.question: Which areas do you cover?
faqs.answer: We cover the whole metro area and up to 30 km beyond the city limits.
examples: do you come to my suburb

faqs.question: Do you give free quotes?
faqs.answer: Yes, quotes are free. Send photos and a description at flowfix.test/quote and we reply within one business day.

faqs.question: How can I pay?
faqs.answer: We accept cards, bank transfer and cash. Payment is due on completion of the job.

faqs.question: Are you licensed and insured?
faqs.answer: Yes, all plumbers are licensed and we carry full liability insurance.
